class.name: CabinLogic
class.brief_description: The logic of a vehicle's cabs.
class.description: Attached to the vehicle in [CabinSystem] ([method CabinSystem.vehicle_attach_cab_logic]). It registers the control handlers of one cabin in [CabinSystem]; [CabinSystem] registers it for the cabin the vehicle's driver sits in and moves it along when the driver changes cabins. It needs no 3D cab: whoever drives - the player by keys and mouse, the AI - reports manipulations with [method CabinSystem.act]. The player's hand on a control - a key, a click on its widget - is one of [method press], [method release], [method increase], [method decrease], which decide what the control does with it as the cab has it. A plugin's cab logic derives from it and overrides the virtual methods.

method.name: _get_action
method.description: What [method get_action] answers; [param gesture] is a [enum Gesture].

method.name: decrease
method.description: The driver's hand moves the control one position (or, held, a knob) down.

method.name: get_action
method.description: The input action whose key makes [param gesture] on the control in this cab; empty when no key does.

method.name: increase
method.description: The driver's hand moves the control one position (or, held, a knob) up.

method.name: input
method.description: The player's keys of the cab's controls.

method.name: press
method.description: The driver's hand pushes the control: a button is pressed, a two-position switch flipped.

method.name: register
method.description: Registers the handlers of the vehicle's [param cabin] (a [VehicleServer] cabin).

method.name: release
method.description: The driver's hand lets the control go: a push button springs back, a held lever stops.

method.name: unregister
method.description: Unregisters the handlers registered by [method register].

constants.constant: A press of the control ([method press]).
A move one position up ([method increase]).
A move one position down ([method decrease]).
